description: Agent Childcare Records: submit a licensed childcare facility record with the childcare inspection, childcare enrollment and condition records it answers to: the reading moment; the facility with its reference, name, kind (a childcare center or a family childcare home), its license as the record states it (license number, issuing licensing agency, issue and expiry dates, licensed capacity, age groups served and the license conditions it names), its license status (active, provisional or suspended) and the moment the status took effect, the inspection references it claims and the enrollment it states for a day; each inspection the childcare inspection record shows with its id, reference, the moment inspected and the license action it records (none, provisional or suspended); each enrollment total with its id, reference, the day counted and the aggregate count; each entry in the family’s other records with its id, reference, the license condition it answers to, the record it sits in and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the facility record and its license, each inspection the facility record claims against the inspection record, the enrollment it states against the enrollment total on its day, the license status against the later license actions, the license expiry and the enrollment after a suspension, and each license condition against an entry behind it, and counts them, and names divergent childcare facility records: an inspection the facility record claims that the inspection record does not show, enrollment it states that the enrollment record does not support, a license status the inspection or enrollment records contradict, and a license condition with no entry behind it; then a license missing its number, issuer or expiry date and an inspection claimed twice, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No inspection record beside claimed inspections, no enrollment totals beside a stated figure or no entries beside named conditions leaves those points unverified. Inspections, entries and the facility match by letters and digits, so INS-2604 and INS 2604 are one inspection, license conditions by their words with plurals folded, counts as whole numbers, dates by the day. This reads the operator’s master record of the facility, with the license and its conditions read as part of it. Verdict childcare_facility_record_divergent, childcare_facility_record_partial, childcare_facility_record_unverified or childcare_facility_record_consistent. POST /api/childcare-facility-record-check. Reads the childcare records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no childcare facility, contacts no licensing agency or parent, runs no background check on anyone and issues no license, credential or certification, which stay with the operator and the licensing agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Childcare Records reads licensed childcare facility and staff compliance records, for childcare centers and family childcare homes, and never a record about an individual child: health records belong to Agent Healthcare, education records belong to Agent Education, food-safety records belong to Agent Food Safety Records, staff checks read the licensing qualification file and never run background checks, and pet daycare is not childcare (Agent Veterinary Records reads animal records). It reads a childcare operator’s own compliance paper: the childcare facility record with its license and license conditions, the licensing agency’s childcare inspection record, the childcare staff record with training entries, each childcare credential as issued, the childcare enrollment record and the childcare ratio record as counts, the childcare incident record from its date, type, notification and filing fields, and the childcare safety record with the emergency plan, each against the inspection, enrollment, condition, schedule, violation, requirement, qualification, placement, reliance, capacity, staffing, notification, drill and corrective action records it answers to. The family’s ground is the childcare facility’s paper trail: what the facility record and its license claim, whether the inspections hold up, what the staff and credential records support, what the enrollment and ratio counts show, and whether the incident log and the safety record line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-childcare-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-childcare-records/.

enrollment.description: Each enrollment total, an aggregate count.

entries.description: Each entry answering a license condition.

condition.description: The license condition the entry answers to.

capacity.description: The count of children the license allows.

conditions.description: License conditions the facility record names.

enrolled_at.description: The stated enrollment day, such as 2026-03-02.

kind.description: A childcare center or a family childcare home.

status_at.description: When the status took effect, such as 2026-03-02.

inspections.description: Each inspection the inspection record shows.

action.description: License action recorded: none, provisional or suspended.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
